mentions.name: Kevlar
mentions.description: A static site generator written entirely from scratch in C with no dependencies. It consumes markdown and immediately outputs HTML. Kevlar v3 adds more spec-compliant markdown AST-based parsing, a better .ini config parser with namespacing, and more powerful templating tags like IF and FOR with lisp-like configuration. The author uses it to build their personal blog.
mentions.source_excerpt:
About 2 years back I began working on a very simple markdown compiler, it was “immediate” in that it would consume markdown and immediately spit html. That project turned into a whole static site generator called Kevlar — https://github.com/aadv1k/kevlar

Entirely built from scratch in C without any dependencies.
